items.title: D'Imperio interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2014
items.q: but I was on Woody Herman’s band and I was on Maynard Ferguson’s band, I was with Anita O’Day and things like that.

ctx.x: Yeah. What’s the scene? I mean I go into Central Park now and I hear guys playing their asses off. But they’ve got their cases open for nickels and dimes and quarters and a couple of one dollar bills that they probably put in there themselves. So I don’t recommend getting into the music business. I mean I caught the tail end of it with the guys that were still — I mean not Glenn Miller — but I was on Woody Herman’s band and I was on Maynard Ferguson’s band, I was with Anita O’Day and things like that. I was with…
Did you ever witness any racial incidents or that kind of thing in your career? I know as you said, your time in the business was supposedly a little after much of that was worked out.
